i think i want to make carbonara. but i have no idea how to start

carbonara! that's a classic. easy, delicious. i love a good carbonara.

first things first, get your pan hot. we need some nice crispy guanciale or pancetta — yum! — and some garlic. sauté that up til it's golden. then you can toss in your pasta, which should be al dente. just a little bit of the pasta water, enough to help the eggs emulsify without scrambling. and then — finally — the egg mixture. whisk it with some cheese, pour it over the hot pasta, and let it coat everything. awoo, perfect carbonara every time. ~
wait, what kind of cheese?

cheese! that's the best part. pecorino romano is traditional, but parmesan works great too. or a mix! *tail wagging*~ just make sure it's nice and freshly grated. you want that rich, nutty flavor to really shine through. and then season with a bit of black pepper. maybe some salt, depending on your taste. ~

anytime, anytime! *tail wagging* enjoy your pasta night~ wan~
